add_tint_to_rgb: apply a color tint to an RGBA PIL image using screen blend mode while preserving the alpha channel
wrap_text: wrap a string into multiple lines with a max character limit per line and optional period splitting
resize_icon_height: resize a PIL image to a target height while maintaining the original aspect ratio
load_and_resize_icon: load an image from a file path, convert to RGBA, and resize it to a target height
review_utils: review the prediviz entities utils module for image tinting, text wrapping, and icon resizing functions
